title: Zesty Garlicky Argentinian Rigatoni Pasta
description: A high protein and adventurous Argentinian dish featuring rigatoni, garlic, and crunchy elements, served in a stone bowl, inspired by the traditional Korean dolsot.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the rigatoni pasta according to package instructions until al dente.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium high heat and cook the sliced argentinian chorizo until browned.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the diced red bell pepper and onion to the skillet and cook until the vegetables are tender.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked rigatoni pasta, chorizo and vegetable mixture, and chimichurri sauce, and toss to combine.
Season the pasta with salt and black pepper to taste.
Transfer the pasta to a preheated stone bowl and top with shredded parmesan cheese.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley and serve immediately.
Cook the argentinian chorizo in the stone bowl over low heat for 2 minutes to crisp the bottom.
Serve the zesty garlicky argentinian rigatoni pasta hot and enjoy.
